page: UpCloud GPU-64xCPU-320GB-4xRTXPRO6000 is a GPU-accelerated server configured with 64 vCPUs and 64 physical cores powered by an AMD EPYC 9555 processor running at 2.0 GHz on the x86_64 architecture. The system features 320.0 GB of system memory, providing 5.0 GB of RAM per core. It is equipped with four NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition GPUs, delivering a combined 382 GB of VRAM. This server does not include local storage, meaning external storage solutions must be attached. It operates on a KVM hypervisor and includes one complimentary public IPv4 address.

Benchmark results place this server in the top tier for both single-core and multi-core CPU performance, with stress-ng scores of 3717.18 and 236275.73 respectively. Memory bandwidth is highly efficient, reaching 13367.03 GB/sec for cached small blocks and 465.67 GB/sec for uncached large blocks. The system demonstrates exceptional processing capabilities in data decompression, achieving a multi-threaded bzip3 decompression speed of 1107.38 GB/sec. For database operations, it handles 223.2 million Redis SET operations per second.

This hardware profile is optimized for heavy parallel processing workloads, particularly machine learning and large language model inference. In testing, the server achieved prompt processing speeds of 7887.2 tokens per second and text generation speeds of 213.78 tokens per second using a medium 7B LLM model. Given the inclusion of four high-end GPUs and a high-density AMD EPYC processor, the server offers strong qualitative cost efficiency for enterprise-grade AI workloads, data science pipelines, and highly parallelized compute tasks that do not require local storage.
